Windows x64.

## Changes

- Added configurable keyboard shortcuts for switching layouts and a shortcut-capture dialog.
- Improved scrolling in management windows with smooth scrolling.
- Improved layout-switching behavior and management controls.
- Improved the separate download-statistics helper.

## Downloads

- **WITH NET10**: single EXE with .NET 10 included.
- **REQUIRES NET10**: smaller single EXE; requires .NET 10 Desktop Runtime.
